from: live test 2 (storyboard), plan v1: "no count shown" became a ring of 18 dots

shots.summary: A wide grid of small neutral dots; on "selected by lottery" a handful light gold in seeded random order and move into a circle; label "Selected by lottery"
shots.action: 16.9 s (frame starts covered in bright teal from the wipe, which clears to the right): a wide grid of small slate dots, too many to count at a glance, fades up across the upper two thirds of the frame. 21.3 s: about 18 dots turn gold (#F2B705) one after another, seeded random order (seed fixed in code), 110ms apart. 21.6 s: label "Selected by lottery" (Display Sans 900, 68px, white, on a navy box so it reads over the grid) appears centred under where the ring will form. 23.0 to 24.4 s: the gold dots glide into a ring at centre (radius 200px, 900ms, ease-out cubic), grow to 25px and a thin gold circle line fades in at 24.0 s, while the rest of the grid dims to 15%. 24.4 s: source line. Hold. No number anywhere.
shots.transition_out: Cross-fade 400ms; the gold ring returns in S7
reads: 23.0 to 24.4 s: gold dots form the ring

source_line.position: under the fact, above the caption band

shots.notes: Dots are residents, illustrative: no count or number shown, seeded random order so every render matches.

shots.summary: The gold ring returns as icon people discs in mixed support colours; "Demographics" then "Politics" build one per phrase
shots.action: 31.2 s: a thin gold ring at centre with icon-person discs set closely around it (gold, purple, sky, green, teal; white round-headed silhouettes inside) fades up; they overlap so it reads as a group, not a count. 34.4 s: "Demographics" (Display Sans 900, 68px, white) lands left of the ring. 35.4 s: "Politics" lands right of it. No party colours, no bars, no numbers. 35.9 s: source line. Hold.
shots.transition_out: Bright teal vertical bar wipe (section break)

source_line.position: under the fact, above the caption band

shots.notes: Gate change kept: no bars, no numbers, no count of people. Support colours only, no party colours.

shots.summary: Step 2 "Deliberate": small table groups of icons with a facilitator disc; speech bubbles drift to the middle and join into one gold check, "Broad consensus"
shots.action: 51.6 s: "STEP 2" and "Deliberate" replace the step label. 51.8 s: three small round tables (house teal) spread across the frame, each with a few icon-person discs around it in support colours. 52.6 s, on "trained facilitators": a bright teal ring and a small facilitator pictogram mark one disc at each table. 54.4 to 57.4 s, on "listen, deliberate and weigh tradeoffs": white speech bubbles (no text) rise from the tables and drift to the centre, staggered. 58.3 s, on "broad consensus": the bubbles merge into one gold disc with a navy check (600ms, ease-out); label "Broad consensus" (Text Sans 600, 34px, white) under it. 58.6 s: source line. Hold.
